settings.title: Paused
settings.volumeMasterOff: The master volume is at zero: nothing is heard.
settings.volumeNote: A volume at zero mutes its category. Your choice is saved.
settings.qualityNote: Auto starts balanced and lowers itself if the game runs slowly on your device.
settings.controlsHint: Press an action, then the key you want for it. Esc cancels.
settings.keyReserved: That key is reserved. Try another one.
settings.keySwapped: {key} was used by {action}: they swap keys.
settings.touchPreview: Where the three buttons are on your screen
settings.touchEditNote: Drag each button where it is comfortable for your hands, change its size and save. Nothing is pressed while you edit.
settings.editorHint: Drag each button. It stops where something is in the way: the shaded areas are kept for the life, the pause button and the boss bar.
settings.editorMove: Move {button}. The arrow keys move it too.
settings.editorReserved: Nothing here attacks, dashes or casts: the buttons only move.
settings.reduceFlashesNote: Softens the pulses at the edges of the screen; removes the white flash and the blinking of the life, softens its wave of light, and swaps the white glow of powers and bottles for a steady cyan one.
settings.reduceShakeNote: The camera does not shake when something hits.
controls.padNote: The buttons of the gamepad cannot be remapped.
controls.wallJump: Wall jump (against a wall, in the air)
controls.touchMoveHow: Drag a finger on the side of the screen that has no buttons (the left half by default). The farther, the faster.
controls.touchJumpHow: Without lifting the finger, drag it up. Let go early for a short hop.
controls.touchCrouchHow: Without lifting the finger, drag it down.
controls.touchDropHow: Flick the finger down with a quick gesture.
controls.touchButtonsHow: Three buttons you can place wherever you like with “Edit layout”. The ability button appears when a card is equipped.
controls.touchAirJumpHow: In the air, bring the finger back down and drag it up again. Against a wall, just drag it up.
controls.touchSlamHow: In the air, hold the finger down and tap the attack button.
controls.touchAirDashHow: In the air, tap the dash button once more.
controls.touchBottleHow: Tap one of the bottles of the interface, or the chip that appears when you are hurt and have one ready.
controls.touchInteractHow: Tap the icon that appears over an object when you are within reach.
controls.touchPauseHow: The icon at the top right.
saves.title: Saved games
saves.emptyActive: A new game, not saved yet
saves.damaged: It cannot be read. A copy is kept in case it can be recovered.
saves.recovered: It was recovered from the previous copy.
saves.confirmDelete: Delete game {n}? This cannot be undone.
saves.confirmDeleteDamaged: Delete game {n} and the damaged copy that is kept? This cannot be undone.
saves.confirmNew: This replaces game {n} with a new one. It cannot be undone.
saves.confirmImport: This replaces game {n} with the chosen file. It cannot be undone.
saves.switchNote: This game is saved as it stands before you switch.
saves.loadFailed: The games could not be read. Open this screen again; if it keeps happening, reload the page.
saves.conflict: Another tab saved this game after this one. This tab no longer saves, so as not to overwrite the other: reload the page to go on from the latest save.
saves.exportFailed: The file could not be created.
saves.exportNone: There is no readable game to export.
saves.importUnreadable: That file is not a game of this title.
saves.importTooBig: That file is too big to be a game.
saves.importStorage: The imported game could not be saved.
saves.where: Games are kept in this browser. They are not synced between devices and are lost if you clear the site's data, uninstall the app or lose the device. Export a copy to keep it safe.
saves.auto: The game saves itself when you win something, when you rest at a shrine, every half minute of play and when the page is closed.
saves.persisted: The browser has promised not to clear them to make room.
saves.notPersisted: The browser may clear them if it needs room.
saves.persistAsk: Ask the browser to protect them
saves.persistDenied: The browser did not grant the protection.
saves.unavailable: This browser does not allow saving: what you play will be lost when you close the page.
